questions.question: A tank is 1/2 full. After adding 18 litres of water, the tank becomes 2/3 full. What is the capacity of the tank?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 2/3 - 1/2 = 4/6 - 3/6 = 1/6. This 1/6 of capacity = 18 litres. Full capacity = 18 × 6 = 108 litres.

questions.question: Which fraction is closest to 1 whole?
questions.explanation: Compare the difference from 1: 5/6 is 1/6 away, 7/8 is 1/8 away, 9/10 is 1/10 away, 11/12 is 1/12 away. 1/12 is the smallest difference, so 11/12 is closest to 1.

questions.question: Mary had some money. She spent 1/3 on books and 1/4 of the remainder on food. What fraction of her original money is left?
A bottle is 3/5 full of juice. After drinking 120 ml, the bottle becomes 1/2 full. What is the capacity of the bottle?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 3/5 - 1/2 = 6/10 - 5/10 = 1/10. This 1/10 of capacity = 120 ml. Full capacity = 120 × 10 = 1200 ml.

questions.question: Arrange these fractions from smallest to largest: 3/4, 5/6, 7/8
Tom ate 2/5 of a pizza. Jerry ate 3/7 of the same pizza. Who ate more?
questions.explanation: Compare 2/5 and 3/7. Common denominator 35: 2/5 = 14/35, 3/7 = 15/35. Since 15/35 is greater than 14/35, Jerry ate more.

questions.question: A box is 2/3 full of marbles. After adding 24 marbles, the box becomes 5/6 full. How many marbles can the box hold when full?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 5/6 - 2/3 = 5/6 - 4/6 = 1/6. This 1/6 of capacity = 24 marbles. Full capacity = 24 × 6 = 144 marbles.

questions.question: Which fraction lies exactly halfway between 1/3 and 1/2?
questions.explanation: Convert to common denominator 12: 1/3 = 4/12, 1/2 = 6/12. The fraction halfway between 4/12 and 6/12 is 5/12.

questions.question: Sarah has 3/4 of a cake. She gives 1/3 of what she has to her friend. What fraction of the whole cake does her friend receive?
questions.explanation: Friend receives 1/3 of 3/4. This is 1/3 × 3/4 = 3/12 = 1/4 of the whole cake.

questions.question: A jar is 4/5 full of honey. After using 150 g of honey, the jar becomes 3/4 full. What is the capacity of the jar?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 4/5 - 3/4 = 16/20 - 15/20 = 1/20. This 1/20 of capacity = 150 g. Full capacity = 150 × 20 = 3000 g.

questions.question: Which fraction is greater than 3/5 but less than 4/5?
questions.explanation: Convert to tenths: 3/5 = 6/10, 4/5 = 8/10. 7/10 is between 6/10 and 8/10.

questions.question: If 3/4 of a number is 36, what is 5/6 of the same number?
questions.explanation: If 3/4 of number = 36, then 1 unit = 36 ÷ 3 = 12, whole number = 12 × 4 = 48. 5/6 of 48 = 48 ÷ 6 × 5 = 8 × 5 = 40.

questions.question: A tank is 1/4 full. After adding 42 litres, the tank becomes 3/5 full. What is the capacity of the tank?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 3/5 - 1/4 = 12/20 - 5/20 = 7/20. This 7/20 of capacity = 42 litres. Full capacity = 42 × 20 ÷ 7 = 120 L.

questions.question: Which fraction is closest to 1/2?
questions.explanation: Compare distance from 1/2: 4/9 is 1/18 away, 5/9 is 1/18 away, 6/11 is 1/22 away, 7/13 is 1/26 away. 1/26 is smallest, so 7/13 is closest.

questions.question: Arrange from largest to smallest: 2/3, 3/5, 5/8
A bag is 3/7 full of rice. After adding 36 kg of rice, the bag becomes 5/7 full. What is the capacity of the bag?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 5/7 - 3/7 = 2/7. This 2/7 of capacity = 36 kg. Full capacity = 36 × 7 ÷ 2 = 126 kg.

questions.question: Which fraction has the smallest value?
A container is 2/5 full. After removing 20 litres, the container becomes 1/3 full. What is the capacity of the container?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 2/5 - 1/3 = 6/15 - 5/15 = 1/15. This 1/15 of capacity = 20 litres. Full capacity = 20 × 15 = 300 litres.

questions.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 15/24 in simplest form?
questions.explanation: Divide numerator and denominator by their HCF (3): 15 ÷ 3 / 24 ÷ 3 = 5/8.

questions.question: A bottle is 5/8 full of water. After drinking 150 ml, the bottle becomes 1/2 full. What is the capacity of the bottle?
questions.explanation: Difference in fraction: 5/8 - 1/2 = 5/8 - 4/8 = 1/8. This 1/8 of capacity = 150 ml. Full capacity = 150 × 8 = 1200 ml.
